en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Isa, from Muhammed bin Yahya, the silk maker, from Hammad bin Uthman, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:
I asked him about forged statement. He said: From it is the saying of a man to the one who sings: «You did well».
